## Prefer-A draft

## In plain English
After Greptile is CLEAN, merge sometimes never happens because closeout picks a dirty Approach1 babysit worktree at the PR tip (actives parked/deleted for sole-pin) and the wait loop keeps polling that local refuse for minutes. Prefer a clean matching worktree when one exists; if every match is dirty, exit in one poll with a named remediation instead of looking frozen.

## Approaches

### Approach A (Prefer-A lean)
1. Enumerate all linked worktrees at the PR head SHA; prefer one whose xbrief/vbrief porcelain is clean for closeout/wait-mergeable.
2. When every SHA match is lifecycle-dirty (or the only match is), refuse closed with a message that names the dirty path and remediation `git checkout HEAD -- xbrief/active/`.
3. Treat that dirty-lifecycle closeout refuse as a one-poll terminal local refuse in the merge-readiness monitor path so `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` does not poll for minutes on mergeState=clean while blocked-on names the dirty babysit.
4. Keep Approach1 sole-pin parking usable; do not ignore parked deletions as a silent closeout bypass.
5. Regression: dirty babysit + clean product dest at same SHA → select clean and proceed; dirty-only → non-zero within one poll naming path + remediation.

### Approach B
Teach closeout to ignore Approach1 sole-pin `D xbrief/active/*` parking as non-dirty. Reject: weakens the committed-PR-head brief guarantee and invents a special-case dirty classifier.

### Approach C
Docs-only: tell operators to restore actives before wait-mergeable. Reject: leaves the freeze class live under YOLO through-merge.

### Reject
- Absorbing unrelated orphan-active leftover into this ticket.
- Skipping verify:pr-closeout-attestable for babysit trees.
- Auto `git checkout` mutation inside closeout without an explicit operator/remediation path.

- packages/core/src/pr-closeout-attestable/pr-head-assert.ts
- packages/core/src/pr-closeout-attestable/evaluate.ts (caller of findWorktreeAtSha)
- packages/core/src/pr-monitor/monitor.ts (one-poll terminal on dirty-lifecycle / EXIT_CONFIG_ERROR class)
- packages/core/src/pr-merge-readiness/compute.ts only if closeout dirty needs a named terminal marker

Prefer A with the amendments below. B weakens the existing disk-based closeout guarantee; C leaves the polling failure live.

Verification: pin-read at de65e613d19490f6f1af813a090d69f8c0679583; HEAD matches and the reviewed source directories have no diff against that SHA. Read issue body and comments only through 6730189091. This is source-path verification, not an executed regression test.

### C1 — blocks-the-design: distinguish local dirty refusal from external exit 2 (P2)

Evidence: `applyCloseoutAttestableGate` in `pr-merge-readiness/compute.ts:771` maps closeout code 2 to `via=error` and `partial_data.closeout_attestable`. `exitCodeFor` maps every `via=error` result to external-error 2; `callReadiness` also emits 2 for exceptions. `monitor.ts:250-254` waits until the cap before returning that error.

Failure: implementing the draft's “EXIT_CONFIG_ERROR class” as an unconditional immediate exit would also terminate recoverable API/network failures. Matching the human dirty-message text instead would couple behavior to prose.

## Problem
`task pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` can sit in a poll loop reporting GitHub `mergeState=clean` while never squash-merging. Operators see "nothing happening" and merge by hand.

Root cause observed on deftai/directive through-merge YOLO (activation #6123; product #6124/#6125):

1. Approach1 babysit worktrees sole-pin by **parking/deleting** tracked `xbrief/active/*` siblings so spawn admission sees one basename.
2. `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` / `verify:pr-closeout-attestable` selects a linked worktree whose HEAD matches the PR tip (`findWorktreeAtSha`).
3. That selection often lands on the **dirty babysit** tree.
4. Closeout refuses: `lifecycle tree under …/babysit-N has uncommitted xbrief/vbrief changes (D xbrief/active/…)`.
5. Wait stays BLOCKED on that local refuse even when Greptile is CLEAN (conf≥4) and required checks are green.

Repro evidence (PR #6124 tip `405682e652`):
```
verify:pr-closeout-attestable: lifecycle tree under C:/Repos/deft/directive/.deft-scratch/worktrees/babysit-6124 has uncommitted xbrief/vbrief changes (D xbrief/active/…). Closeout reads the committed PR-head brief — commit, stash, or discard local lifecycle edits and retry.
```
Exit 2. Same string appeared as `blocked-on:` in `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` polls.

## What to build
Make the post-CLEAN merge path survive Approach1 sole-pin parking without silent poll-forever:

- Prefer a **clean** PR-head worktree for closeout/wait-mergeable (product dest over dirty babysit), or
- Restore/ignore parked `xbrief/active` deletions that are Approach1 admission artifacts, or
- Fail closed immediately with a one-shot remediation that names the dirty babysit path and `git checkout HEAD -- xbrief/active/` (no multi-minute poll on a local dirty refuse), and/or
- Document that babysit WTs must keep lifecycle clean before parent `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge`.

Tracking/Refs only against related closeout/PR-head work (#3875 class); do not absorb unrelated orphan-active leftover.

## Acceptance
- Given a CLEAN Greptile tip and a dirty babysit WT at the same SHA (deleted tracked actives from sole-pin), `pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge` either merges via a clean matching worktree / recovered lifecycle, or exits non-zero within one poll naming the dirty path and remediation — it must not poll for minutes looking "frozen".
- Approach1 sole-pin parking remains usable for spawn admission.
- Regression test covers dirty babysit selection vs clean product WT at same SHA.

## Workaround (today)
From the babysit or before wait-mergeable: `git checkout HEAD -- xbrief/active/` in the PR-head worktree, or run wait-mergeable with `--project-root` pointing at a clean product dest at the PR tip.

Observed during cohort through-merge-6021-5983-5953-6122 (operator merged #6125/#6124 by hand after wait appeared stuck).
